A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|reconstituted Sith Empire]], in the year [[3653 BBY]]. He served onboard [[Orbital Security Station Six]], a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] monitoring the traffic in and out of the Galactic Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], alongside [[Femi]], a female [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], just prior to an [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] He was killed in the first blast of the battle after after an Imperial [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth Angral|Angral]] ordered his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] to fire on the station, starting the conflict.<ref name="comic" />

==Biography==
Serving onboard [[Orbital Security Station Six]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the capital of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government, this [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived<ref name="comic" /> in the year [[3653 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline 1" /> worked with [[Femi]], a female [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], for [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]], monitoring the traffic in and out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Femi checked into [[Coruscant Control]], reporting that there was nothing in her vicinity, and shared a brief conversation with the dispatcher. She then noticed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in her area and asked the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] for clearance codes. The Sith and the Republic were meeting at [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to discuss terms for ending the [[Great Galactic War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict that had been taking place between them for decades, and the unexpected arrival of their fleet caught the duo off-guard. Rather than transmit a response back to her, [[Darth Angral|Angral]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] from the Empire and leader of the assault, ordered his ship to fire on the satellite, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Femi and her co-worker. This began the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], a battle between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. The conflict ended with the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], an agreement that forced the Republic to abandon long-time allies and give many outlying worlds over to the Sith and put an end to the Great Galactic War in favor of the Sith [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]].<ref name="comic" />

==Personality and traits==
This male was light-skinned with brown hair and worked aboard a satellite orbiting Coruscant for the Coruscant Security Force. His job was to monitor the traffic in and out of the planet with his co-worker, Femi.<ref name="comic" />

==Equipment==
Femi and her co-worker wore a uniform with a black torso, white shoulder pads, and white sleeves. Their pants were also white. The headset that he wore on the job was a silver color.<ref name="comic" />

==Behind the scenes==
This male was created for the first issue of the opening [[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant|arc]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] serving as a prequel to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|Massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] being made by [[BioWare]]. He was not named in the comic and did not speak a word.<ref name="comic" />
